user.title: Select Setup Mode
user.description: Choose how you want to configure your Panasonic AC units.

menu_option_descriptions.hybrid: Combine fast local UDP with MirAIe Cloud MQTT and IR blaster failover.
menu_option_descriptions.ir_device: Configure a standalone AC unit using an IR blaster without a cloud account.
menu_option_descriptions.local_udp: Direct local LAN control over your home Wi-Fi with zero continuous cloud connection.
menu_option_descriptions.cloud: Pure MirAIe Cloud MQTT control without local UDP LAN access.

local_udp.title: Local UDP Setup Mode
local_udp.description: Choose how you want to configure local offline UDP control:

menu_option_descriptions.local_udp_auto: Log in once to fetch local encryption keys automatically, then run purely offline.
menu_option_descriptions.local_udp_manual: Enter your AC unit's IP address, MAC address, and local AES encryption keys directly.

local_udp_auto.title: MirAIe Cloud Bootstrap
local_udp_auto.description: Enter your MirAIe account credentials once to retrieve local UDP keys. After discovery, connection to the cloud can be completely disabled.

local_udp_manual.title: Manual Local UDP Setup
local_udp_manual.description: Enter the local network and encryption parameters for your Panasonic AC unit:

data.name: AC Unit Name (e.g. Living Room AC)

data_description.device_ip: Local static or reserved IP address of your AC unit on your Wi-Fi network (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
data_description.device_mac: MAC address of the AC unit (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
data_description.model_code: Indoor unit model code for capability auto-detection.
data_description.controller_id: Unique 2-to-4 character client identifier sent in local UDP command packets. Defaults to 'ha' (Home Assistant). Only modify this if you run multiple Home Assistant instances or need to distinguish commands from a specific controller (e.g. 'h2', 'ha_dev').
data_description.room_temp_sensor: Optional external temperature sensor entity to report current room temperature for this AC.

data_description.device_ip: Local IP address of the AC on your Wi-Fi network for Local UDP control.
data_description.device_mac: Hardware MAC address of the AC Wi-Fi module (e.g. AA:BB:CC:11:22:33). Required for offline manual Local UDP setup.
data_description.controller_id: Unique 2-to-4 character client identifier sent in local UDP command packets. Defaults to 'ha' (Home Assistant). Only modify this if you run multiple Home Assistant instances or need to distinguish commands from a specific controller (e.g. 'h2', 'ha_dev').
data_description.udp_control_key: Secret 32-byte AES encryption key used for local UDP communication. You can copy this key for manual offline UDP setup or CLI tools.
data_description.udp_control_iv: Secret 16-byte AES initialization vector used for local UDP communication. You can copy this IV for manual offline UDP setup or CLI tools.
data_description.install_date: Date the AC was physically installed or when energy tracking began (MirAIe maintains approximately 8 months of historical telemetry).
data_description.primary_backend: Main transport used to dispatch commands. Local UDP provides instantaneous offline response.
data_description.secondary_backend: Fallback transport automatically used if the primary transport is unreachable.
data_description.hybrid_submode: Select Automatic Failover to switch transports dynamically on outages, or Manual Control.
data_description.blaster_entity_id: Optional IR blaster entity used to transmit commands locally.
data_description.receiver_entity_id: Optional entity used to listen for physical remote button presses.
data_description.room_temp_sensor: Optional external temperature sensor entity to report current room temperature for this AC.
data_description.availability_topic: Optional MQTT LWT topic to track transmitter online/offline status (e.g. tele/tasmota_ir/LWT).
data_description.availability_entity_id: Optional smart plug, router device tracker, status sensor, or helper to monitor blaster availability.
data_description.ir_format: Encoding format expected by your IR transmitter.
data_description.mqtt_topic: MQTT command topic to dispatch Tasmota IR payloads (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_ir/IRsend).

manual_migration_required.title: Manual Upgrade Required for Panasonic AC India
manual_migration_required.description: Panasonic AC India introduces independent per-device entries and local IR blaster support. Auto-migration could not split your legacy account entry automatically. Please delete the old entry under Settings -> Devices & Services -> Panasonic AC India and re-add your account via Add Integration. All your existing entity names, automations, and dashboards will remain unchanged.

migration_successful.title: Panasonic AC India — Local UDP Available
migration_successful.description:
Your Panasonic AC integration has been upgraded to support direct **Local UDP (Wi-Fi) control** alongside MirAIe Cloud and IR.

To enable local Wi-Fi control:
1. Go to **Settings -> Devices & Services -> Panasonic AC India**.
2. Click the **Configure** button next to your AC device.
3. Enter your AC unit's local IP address (UDP encryption keys have already been retrieved from your cloud account).
